name: Hansen's disease (leprosy)
general: Notify; counsel (curable, not hereditary, stop discrimination). Examine contacts — single-dose rifampicin chemoprophylaxis for contacts per NLEP. Nerve function assessment at every visit; self-care for anaesthetic hands and feet. Check G6PD before dapsone if possible.
special: Children 10–14 yr: rifampicin 450 mg monthly, clofazimine 150 mg monthly + 50 mg alternate days, dapsone 50 mg daily; under 10 yr: dose by weight (see NLEP chart / Dose by weight).

rx.dose: 300 mg once a month supervised + 50 mg

rx.drug: Type 2 (ENL): Tab. Prednisolone 40 mg + Clofazimine 300 mg/day
rx.dur: Prednisolone 12 weeks; clofazimine up to 12 months tapering
rx.instr: Thalidomide 100–400 mg/day if steroid-dependent (men, women not of child-bearing potential)

rx.drug: Ofloxacin 400 mg + Minocycline 100 mg + Clofazimine 50 mg
rx.dur: 6 months, then clofazimine + one of them for 18 months

rx.dose: 300 mg once a month supervised + 50 mg
